item.title: Familiar Things, Fresh Eyes: 2 Drawing Challenges That Change How You See
item.description: Use these two transformative challenges to sharpen your artistic vision and turn ordinary household corners into dynamic, mindful compositions.

item.title: Master of the Miniature
item.description: Explore the history of miniature portraits and the intimate, masterful works of Lucy May Stanton.

item.title: The Art of Letting Go
item.description: Artist Carol Peebles shares a lesson in creative fluidity, transforming a distracted portrait session into a symbolic, multi-generational artwork.

item.title: Code Red! An Art Quiz
item.description: Test your art knowledge with this quiz on famous red-themed paintings and the artists behind them.

item.title: Stuff on My Counter
item.description: Discover the variety of color and shape in produce—some of it edible, all of it sketchable.

item.title: Paint Along August: Let's Paint Peaceful Country Nights
item.description: Experience peaceful evenings from the warm glow of a campfire to the silvery moon overhead, with crickets and owls filling the quiet air. In this hands-on workshop, master artist Johannes will guide you in capturing the subtle light of country nights, showing you how to allow your brush to narrate the stories of the evening while making it look like nighttime yet still depicting enough light to see the forms. By the end, your paintings will invite viewers to linger in the calm of serene evenings

item.title: Paint Along October: Mastering the Glow of Sunlit Autumn
item.description: Explore the golden ochres and glowing light of autumn as it bathes trees, hills, and open landscapes—one of the most successful and beloved painting scenes. Master artist Johannes will guide you in capturing the warmth of the season while learning how to simplify tree forms so your paintings remain strong and readable. Discover how light, color, and structure work together to create landscapes that celebrate autumn at its most beautiful.

item.title: Paint Along November: Capturing Impactful Sunsets
item.description: Learn how to paint sunsets that command attention. Master artist Johannes will guide you in using bold color, strong value contrasts, and dramatic skies to create scenes that glow with evening light. Discover how to balance warm and cool tones and let the sky become the star of your painting, capturing the most stunning time of the day.

item.title: Paint Along December: Master Shadows in Landscapes
item.description: Shadows are more than dark shapes—they are a vital component in landscapes. In this workshop, master artist Johannes will teach several must-know principles for creating painterly, see-through shadows with vivid colors that guide the viewer’s eye. Working from photos or plein air without proper training can degrade your shadows, but with the right approach, you’ll capture the subtle interplay of light and dark for landscapes that feel dynamic and three-dimensional.

item.title: Paint Along September: Step Into Timeless Harbor Scenes
item.description: Step into harbors where detailed fishing boats drift quietly, their forms mirrored in the water. Master artist Johannes will guide you in capturing the mood and atmosphere of harbor life, teaching you the anatomy of reflections and showing you how to convey depth and the subtle interplay of water, sky, and vessel details. By the end, your paintings will transport viewers to serene harbors that feel vividly real.

item.title: Studio Snapshot: Tony Ortega
item.description: Tony Ortega and Sylvia Montero’s custom Denver home studios offer a masterclass in balancing domestic life with artistic devotion.

item.title: Sublime Poetry: The Met Presents First U.S. Raphael Retrospective
item.description: Experience the brilliance of a Renaissance icon through the first comprehensive U.S. Raphael retrospective.

item.title: Paint Along August Breakthrough: Portray a Three-Dimensional Still Life
item.description: Learn to make your still life paintings leap off the canvas. Master artist Johannes will guide you in creating convincing three-dimensional forms, from the roundness of fruit to the transparent delicacy of glass. Discover how to capture light, shadow, and reflections so that viewers feel they could take a bite of the fruit or drink from the glass. By the end, your paintings will feel tangible, alive, and irresistibly real.

item.title: Paint Along Oct Breakthrough: Unlock John Singer Sargent's Portrait Secrets
item.description: Master artist Johannes will reveal Sargent’s techniques while repainting his self-portrait live, showing how to capture light, color, and expressive brushwork that bring subjects to life. Learn how to manipulate edges while balancing bold strokes with delicate detail and achieving luminous skin tones. By the end, you’ll have the tools to apply these techniques to your own portrait paintings with confidence and flair.

item.title: Studio Staples: Sizing Up
item.description: Consider the scale of your work to help enrich your painting practice and develop a more intimate and expressive relationship with your own work.
